header.title: Glassmorphism
header.description: Frosted glass pane behind the content: it blurs and saturates whatever sits behind (`backdrop-filter`) and adds a translucent fill, a border and a highlight. `variant` sets the look (`frost`, `clear`, `tinted`, `heavy` or `sheen`) and `trigger` when it applies. It's always on by default.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. With `hover` or `click` the pane only shows while active; `duration` is how long it takes to fade in and out.

card.title: Glass card
card.description: With the defaults (`variant="frost"`, `intensity="md"`) the pane blurs `16px`, saturates to `160%` and has a white fill at `26%`. Glass needs something behind it to show: here, an image. The pane inherits the root `border-radius` and casts a soft drop shadow.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `frost` is classic frosted glass, `clear` blurs less and barely fills, `tinted` fills a bit more to show off `color` (here `primary-400`), `heavy` blurs and fills more, like smoked glass, and `sheen` adds a highlight that sweeps across the pane in a loop.

image.title: On an image
image.description: Positioned over an image, it works as a readable caption. The root is `inline-flex` and `position: relative`; to place it with `position: absolute` you need a class with higher specificity (`.gemfx-glassmorphism.my-class`).

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover`, the pane shows when the pointer is over it or keyboard focus is on the root or something inside (`:focus-visible`). With `click`, each click turns it on or off. At rest the content sits right on the background.

blur.title: Blur
blur.description: `blur` sets the blur and overrides the one from `intensity`. A number is pixels; a string is used as is (`"1.5rem"`).

saturate.title: Saturation
saturate.description: `saturate` is the background saturation as a percentage (`100` keeps it as is, lower mutes it, higher boosts it). Without a value, `intensity` sets it.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the fill and, when `blur` and `saturate` are missing, those two as well: `sm` 8px / 120% / 16%, `md` 16px / 160% / 26%, `lg` 28px / 190% / 40%. Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` tints the fill, the border and the highlight. Takes any CSS color, variables included. Shows best with `variant="tinted"`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long the pane takes to appear and disappear with `hover` or `click`; `delay` postpones it. It doesn't change the `sheen` sweep speed (fixed at `3200ms`).

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the `sheen` sweep. `isDisabled` hides the pane and keeps the content interactive.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild` the effect mounts on the child, with no wrapping `div`. The child keeps its own box (`display`, width, no `overflow: hidden`); it only gets `position: relative` and `isolation` so the pane sits behind its content and frosts the backdrop, not the text. The child shouldn't paint an opaque background: the glass would frost that background instead of the image.

texts.title: Your own card
texts.copy: No wrapper: the article itself is the glass.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onGlassmorphism` fires when the pane turns on and `outGlassmorphism` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The pane doesn't block clicks on the content.

texts.body: Hover the card (or Tab to the button) to frost it and click the button.

tailwind.title: No highlight
tailwind.copy: Large radius, pink tint and the diagonal highlight hidden.

header.title: Glassmorphism API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Glassmorphism`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/glassmorphism` along with its `glassmorphism.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes (except color, which is its own prop) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic.

items.contrast: Contrast depends on what's behind. Check it over the lightest and darkest parts of the background, and raise intensity or use heavy if the text is hard to read.
items.reducedTransparency: With prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce the blur is removed and the pane becomes a solid fill: color at the variant's fill (36% at most) mixed with --gemfx-glassmorphism-solid-base (dark by default), so light text keeps its contrast.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the pane transition is removed and the sheen highlight stays still and dimmer.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the sheen moving. Use it only when essential.
items.decorative: The pane layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover", keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside) does the same as the pointer: it shows the pane and fires onGlassmorphism and outGlassmorphism. Mouse focus doesn't count. The root isn't focusable on its own: it needs a control inside or a tabIndex.
items.performance: backdrop-filter is expensive, especially with large blurs. Avoid many large panes at once or over animated backgrounds.

items.root: Root. `position: relative` and `isolation: isolate`; with the default `div`, also `inline-flex` and `max-width: 100%`. With `asChild` the child keeps its `display`.
items.variant: Active variant. Adjusts the border and the inner highlight.
items.trigger: Added with `trigger="hover"` or `"click"` (there's no class for `always`). Sets `cursor: pointer`.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the pane and removes the blur.
items.layer: Decorative layer behind the content (`aria-hidden`, `z-index: 0`; `-1` with `asChild`).
items.pane: The glass: fill, border, shadow, `backdrop-filter` and the fade in/out transition. It clips the highlights without clipping its own shadow.
items.highlight: Static diagonal highlight. Its opacity follows `intensity`.
items.sheen: Light strip that sweeps the pane every `3200ms`. Only exists with `variant="sheen"`.
items.surface: Wraps the child, above the pane (`z-index: 1`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: All of them except `--gemfx-glassmorphism-color` and `--gemfx-glassmorphism-solid-base` are written inline on every render, so you can only change them through the props. The color is inline only when you pass `color`; otherwise you can override it from a class, like the solid base.

items.color: Color of the fill, border and highlights. Set by `color`; default `var(--gem-palette-neutral-0)` (white).
items.blur: Background blur. Comes from `blur` or from `intensity` and the variant (`clear` × 0.75, `heavy` × 1.45).
items.saturate: Background saturation. Comes from `saturate` or from `intensity`.
items.fill: Fill opacity, between `6%` and `72%`. Comes from `intensity` and the variant (`clear` × 0.55, `tinted` × 1.15, `heavy` × 1.35, `sheen` × 0.9). No prop.
items.intensity: Intensity as a percentage; drives the diagonal highlight opacity.
items.duration: Pane transition duration. Set by `duration`; default `280ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the transition and the sheen. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.solidBase: Base of the solid fill under `prefers-reduced-transparency`. No prop; default `var(--gem-palette-neutral-950)`. Change it from a class if the text on the glass is dark.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Glassmorphism reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.easingStandard: Curve of the pane transition and the `sheen` sweep.
items.neutral0: Default glass color. If gem-system isn't loaded, falls back to `#ffffff`.
items.neutral950: Color of the pane shadow and default of `--gemfx-glassmorphism-solid-base`. If gem-system isn't loaded, falls back to `#111316`.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content sits on the glass and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Look, color, blur, saturation and intensity.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Pane fade in and out, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it applies and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Content that sits on the glass.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, with no wrapping `div`. The child keeps its box and the pane sits behind its content. With void elements (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the wrapping `div`.
items.variant: `frost` classic frosted, `clear` lighter, `tinted` more fill to show off `color`, `heavy` denser, `sheen` with an animated highlight.
items.color: Glass tint. Any CSS color; without a value, white (`--gem-palette-neutral-0`).
items.blur: Background blur. A number is pixels (negatives become `0`); a string is used as is. Without a value, `intensity` sets it: `8`, `16` or `28` px, adjusted by the variant.
items.saturate: Background saturation as a percentage (`140` → `140%`). Without a value, `intensity` sets it: `120`, `160` or `190`.
items.intensity: Sets the fill and, when missing, `blur` and `saturate`. Token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Duration of the pane fade in and out with `hover` or `click`. Negatives become `0`.
items.delay: Delay before the pane shows. Also delays the first `sheen` sweep.
items.trigger: `always` always on, `hover` while the pointer is over it or it has keyboard focus, `click` toggles on each click.
items.isActive: Shows the pane. When `false` it hides it and `outGlassmorphism` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Hides the pane; the child stays interactive. `outGlassmorphism` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the `sheen` sweep even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onGlassmorphism: Fires when the pane turns on: on mount with `always`, when the pointer or keyboard focus enters, or when toggled on by click.
items.outGlassmorphism: Fires when it turns off: when the pointer or focus leaves, when toggled off by click, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-glassmorphism-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
